clusters.pick_reason: #2600's changeset explicitly covers a superset of the fix: alongside settling parked JSON-mode POSTs on close, it also clears `_requestToStreamMapping` (previously left unset by close(), which let send() resolve against a retired correlation after an in-flight `storeEvent()` await and leak both the response and the correlation), and it states the fix applies to both `WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport` and the `NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport` wrapper. #2692's changeset only addresses the parked-JSON-response half of this (returning a per-request JSON-RPC -32000 'Connection closed' error instead of #2600's 404 'Session not found', with grouping for batched POSTs) and does not mention the `_requestToStreamMapping` leak/race, so keeping #2600 and porting #2692's batched-request grouping and JSON-RPC error body into it preserves strictly more of the fixed behavior than the reverse.
